name: transcribe
description: Local, open-source meeting notes for macOS. Transcribes recordings locally with whisper-cpp, detects meeting boundaries, attributes speakers with sherpa-onnx, and generates structured notes via an LLM.
pipeline_stages: whisper.py: local transcription via ffmpeg + whisper-cli + Silero VAD
calendars.py: EventKit calendar lookup (titles, attendees, boundaries)
segmentation.py: meeting boundary detection (calendar / silence gaps / LLM)
diarize.py: sherpa-onnx voice clustering and speaker attribution
notes.py: LLM speaker naming and structured notes generation

modules.role: argument parsing, dispatch, doctor, calendar-check, mic
~/.transcribe/config.yaml load/save + DEFAULT_CONFIG
CoreAudio: microphone-in-use detection
CoreMediaIO: camera-in-use detection
meeting-detection state machine, drives OBS via WebSocket
rumps menu bar app with manual override
ffmpeg/ffprobe: probe, extract audio, lossless video cut
assembles Whisper prompt from calendar + mined glossary
Segment and Meeting dataclasses
transcription with VAD, model download
sherpa-onnx speaker clustering and attribution
EventKit lookup; source registry for future backends
meeting boundary detection (three-signal)
notes generation and speaker naming via LLM
provider dispatch: Anthropic forced-tool-call + OpenAI JSON mode
Markdown / HTML / transcript renderers
pipeline orchestration and filing
watchdog directory watcher and file-stability wait
launchd plist generation
resolves linkable URL for destination folder
Slack webhook / bot-token notifications
optional Google Drive folder URL resolution
TLS CA bundle fixup for frozen binaries

ci_workflows: ci.yml: lint + format + pytest on macos-latest and ubuntu-latest

privacy.offline_mode: set llm_provider to empty or omit api key
